title: Able Archer 83, 4 to 11 November 1983
zeroNote: H-hour is the morning of 11 November, when the exercise executed its follow-on nuclear strike; times are hours from it, so the week before runs negative

steps.text: SCENARIO: ORANGE OPENS HOSTILITIES IN ALL REGIONS OF ALLIED COMMAND EUROPE (EXERCISE FICTION, DOCUMENTED)
steps.source: SHAPE exercise report, NSA EBB 427: hostilities on 4 November

steps.text: SCENARIO: ORANGE INITIATES THE USE OF CHEMICAL WEAPONS (EXERCISE FICTION, DOCUMENTED)
steps.source: SHAPE exercise report, NSA EBB 427: 6 November

steps.text: DAY 1 · ABLE ARCHER BEGINS · SACEUR REQUESTS POLITICAL GUIDANCE ON THE USE OF NUCLEAR WEAPONS · THE 170-FLIGHT RADIO-SILENT AIRLIFT OF 19,000 SOLDIERS IS UNDER WAY
steps.source: NSA EBB 427: SACEUR's request early on Day 1, 7 November; the Military Airlift Command report on Reforger 83, 172 missions

steps.text: HEADQUARTERS SHIFT FROM THE PERMANENT WAR HEADQUARTERS TO THE ALTERNATE, CREST HIGH AT BIRKENFELD, UNDER SIMULATED CHEMICAL ATTACK
steps.source: Seventh Air Division after-action report, 1 December 1983, NSA EBB 427

steps.text: SOVIET AIR UNITS IN EAST GERMANY AND POLAND ON HEIGHTENED READINESS · NUCLEAR-CAPABLE AIRCRAFT ON HIGH ALERT · THE 4TH AIR ARMY'S BOMBERS LOADED · GSFG FIGHTER-BOMBERS AT THIRTY-MINUTE ALERT
steps.source: CIA National Intelligence Daily, 10 November 1983; NSA message of 2 December 1983 (Kutakhov's order); Perroots's addendum of January 1989 (NSA EBB 2021-02-17). The day the alert began is not given; the 8th is the study's reading

steps.text: EVENING OF 8 NOVEMBER: INITIAL NUCLEAR RELEASE APPROVED IN THE EXERCISE, WITH THE NEW CONSULTATION PROCEDURES THROUGH WASHINGTON AND LONDON
MORNING OF 9 NOVEMBER: FIRST USE OF NUCLEAR WEAPONS AGAINST FIXED TARGETS IN ORANGE SATELLITE COUNTRIES, SIMULATED · NOTHING LEAVES THE GROUND
AFTERNOON OF 10 NOVEMBER: FOLLOW-ON NUCLEAR USE APPROVED IN THE EXERCISE
MORNING OF 11 NOVEMBER: THE FOLLOW-ON STRIKE IS EXECUTED IN THE EXERCISE · IN THE RECORD THE EXERCISE ENDS HERE · IN THIS STUDY THE SOVIET COMMAND READS IT AS REAL (COUNTERFACTUAL)
steps.source: SHAPE exercise report, NSA EBB 427; the branch is the study's

steps.text: THE RECORD'S VERDICTS: SNIE 11-10-84 OF MAY 1984, NO GENUINE BELIEF IN IMMINENT CONFLICT · CASEY, JUNE 1984, "A DIMENSION OF GENUINENESS" · PFIAB, FEBRUARY 1990, POTENTIALLY DISASTROUS

airlift.note: Charleston, McGuire and Dover to Rhein-Main; twelve of the 172 missions drawn, the rest implied

sources: National Security Archive EBB 427, Able Archer 83 Declassified (SHAPE exercise report; Seventh Air Division after-action report; MAC report on Reforger 83)
National Security Archive EBB 428, A rather stunning array of indicators
National Security Archive EBB 2021-02-17, Able Archer War Scare Potentially Disastrous (CIA NID of 10 November 1983; Perroots 1989; PFIAB 1990)
National Security Archive EBB 426, The 1983 War Scare Part I (Operation RYaN)
